subject: CAIQ: control owner clarifications & evidence onboarding plan
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@bluepeak.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: security@bluepeak.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: clarifications and evidence intake

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for walking us through the CAIQ crosswalk yesterday. We finished a first pass and have three clarifications before we start pulling evidence for the controls you mapped:

1) CCM section G (Identity & Access Management): you mapped several items to the same Redwood control (IDM-02). Can you confirm whether IDM-02 is the control owner for both human and service account lifecycle, or if there are separate sub-controls? We need explicit owner names for audit purposes.

2) For CCM section D (Data Security): the questionnaire asks for encryption-at-rest algorithm and key lifecycle. The matrix lists "KMS-managed keys" but not key rotation frequency or KMS vendor. Can you provide a short artifact that states algorithm and rotation policy?

3) Logging/evidence sample: BluePeak requires a 48-hour sample of auth and admin activity logs for three representative services. Is a syslog export available, or do you prefer a scoped CloudWatch/Stackdriver snapshot?

Can you also confirm expected timing for a formal evidence upload (we aim to have initial artifacts by next Thursday if possible)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15 if helpful.

Best,
Elena Soto
Senior Security Analyst
BluePeak Health

-----
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@bluepeak.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: clarifications and evidence intake

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below (I’m pushing to the team to collect artifacts this afternoon):

1) IAM / IDM-02:
- Short answer: IDM-02 is an umbrella control covering provisioning, deprovisioning, and service-account lifecycle.
- Action: we will extract a control-owner roster that shows primary and secondary owners per subcontrol. Ben will own the roster upload.

2) Encryption / KMS:
- We use AWS KMS for production key management. Algorithm: AES-256 (CMK symmetric keys). Rotation: automatic annual rotation for CMKs; application-level key rotation is handled per-service (see matrix note).
- Action: Kimberly will attach the KMS policy excerpt and key-rotation statement.

3) Logging sample:
- We can provide a 48-hour sample as a compressed syslog export for the three services you listed, or a CloudWatch snapshot if you prefer structured JSON. Both are feasible; syslog is the quickest.
- Action: Ben will prepare a sanitized syslog sample and mark any PII.

Timing and upload:
- Goal: initial artifact bundle uploaded to the shared Drive link by Thu 2027-06-24 EOD. If that slips, we’ll provide a status update by Tue EOD.

I’ve attached the current CAIQ matrix (redwood_caiq_matrix_v1.xlsx) with inline comments where the mapping might need your interpretation.

If you’re available at 11:00 PST I can run through the matrix with Kimberly and Ben.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_caiq_matrix_v1.xlsx

-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@bluepeak.com>
Cc: alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: clarifications and evidence intake

Elena / team —

Thanks for the clear asks. A few concrete clarifications and what we will upload:

• IDM owner granularity:
  - Primary: Identity & Access team (kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com) — responsible for human identity lifecycle and access review (subcontrols IDM-02a / IDM-02b).
  - Secondary: Platform SRE (ben_carter@redwood-inference.com) — owns service account provisioning and automated rotations (subcontrol IDM-02c).
  - Attachment: control_owner_roster.csv (columns: control_id, primary_owner, secondary_owner, escalation_contact).

• KMS / encryption artifacts:
  - Doc: KMS-key-policy-excerpt.pdf (excerpted policy with algorithm & rotation cadence).
  - Short note: symmetric CMKs (AWS KMS, AES-256), CMKs rotated annually via schedule; application secrets rotated on a quarterly cadence by service owners.

• Logging sample:
  - We will upload: syslog-sample.txt.gz containing redacted auth/admin events for the three services you requested. Redaction notes included in manifest.

• Evidence scoping and provenance:
  - We’ll provide an index file in the Drive bundle that lists each artifact, which CAIQ question(s) it supports, extraction method, and a short provenance statement (who exported it and when).

• Timing: initial bundle to the Drive link by Thu 2027-06-24 18:00 PDT. Ben will post the upload and create a ticket (SEC-8421) with file pointers.

If you want a live walkthrough, confirm 11:00 and we’ll set the meeting invite.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of InfoSec | Redwood Inference

Attachments: control_owner_roster.csv

-----
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@bluepeak.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: clarifications and evidence intake

Team —

Perfect, this plan works for us. Two small asks before upload:

1) In the index, please mark any artifacts that are timeboxed samples vs. enduring proofs (so auditors can find authoritative sources).
2) Please include a short README in the Drive bundle that explains any redactions and how to request unredacted evidence if needed (we’ll follow your process).

We’ll review the bundle when uploaded and post consolidated comments in SEC-8421. If you can add the README and provenance flagging, we’ll be able to move to the next stage of the CAIQ review quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to receiving the upload on Thursday.

Regards,
Elena Soto
Senior Security Analyst
BluePeak Health

Attachments referenced: syslog-sample.txt (sanitized), control_owner_roster.csv, redwood_caiq_matrix_v1.xlsx
